```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(forecast)
library(mgcv)
library(tibble)
library(tseries)
```

```{r}
data <- read_csv("sea-surface-temp.csv", skip = 6,
                 locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"))
cleaned_data <- data %>%
  filter(!is.na(Year)) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.character), as.numeric))
ts_data <- ts(cleaned_data$`Annual anomaly`, start = 1880, end = 2020, frequency = 1)
```

```{r}
plot(ts_data)
adf.test(ts_data)
ts_diff <- diff(ts_data)
adf.test(ts_diff)
plot(ts_diff)
```

```{r}
cleaned_data$Year2 <- cleaned_data$Year^2
cleaned_data$Year3 <- cleaned_data$Year^3
poly_model <- lm(`Annual anomaly` ~ Year + Year2 + Year3, data = cleaned_data)
summary(poly_model)
residuals_poly <- residuals(poly_model)
ts_resid <- ts(residuals_poly, start = 1880, frequency = 1)
plot(ts_resid)
adf.test(ts_resid)
arma_model <- auto.arima(ts_resid, stationary = TRUE, seasonal = FALSE)
summary(arma_model)
future_years <- data.frame(
  Year = 2024:2030,
  Year2 = (2024:2030)^2,
  Year3 = (2024:2030)^3
)
trend_forecast <- predict(poly_model, newdata = future_years)
resid_forecast <- forecast(arma_model, h = 7)$mean
combined_forecast <- trend_forecast + resid_forecast
historical_years <- cleaned_data$Year
forecast_years <- 2024:2030
full_years <- c(historical_years, forecast_years)
full_values <- c(fitted(poly_model) + arma_model$fitted, combined_forecast)
plot(full_years, full_values, type = "l", col = "blue")
lines(cleaned_data$Year, cleaned_data$`Annual anomaly`)
```

```{r}
arima_model <- auto.arima(ts_data)
summary(arima_model)
autoplot(arima_model)
autoplot(forecast(arima_model, h = 10))
```

```{r}
ets_model <- ets(ts_data)
summary(ets_model)
autoplot(ets_model)
autoplot(forecast(ets_model, h = 10))
```

```{r}
gam_data <- cleaned_data %>% select(Year, Anomaly = `Annual anomaly`)
gam_model <- gam(Anomaly ~ s(Year), data = gam_data)
summary(gam_model)
ggplot(gam_data, aes(x = Year, y = Anomaly)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = fitted(gam_model)))
future_years <- tibble(Year = 2021:2030)
future_preds <- predict(gam_model, newdata = future_years, se.fit = TRUE)
future_forecast <- future_years %>%
  mutate(
    fit = future_preds$fit,
    lower = fit - 2 * future_preds$se.fit,
    upper = fit + 2 * future_preds$se.fit
  )
combined_data <- bind_rows(
  gam_data %>% mutate(type = "historical"),
  future_forecast %>% rename(Anomaly = fit) %>% mutate(type = "forecast")
)
ggplot(combined_data, aes(x = Year, y = Anomaly)) +
  geom_point(data = filter(combined_data, type == "historical")) +
  geom_line(size = 1) +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = filter(combined_data, type == "forecast"),
    aes(x = Year, ymin = lower, ymax = upper),
    alpha = 0.2, inherit.aes = FALSE
  )
```

```{r}
checkresiduals(arima_model)
checkresiduals(ets_model)
```
